subsegment: Specialty chemicals plant — greenfield or major expansion (200-2000 TPD)
description: Greenfield or expansion specialty chemical plants (e.g., polymers, intermediates, electronic-grade chemicals) executed as fixed-price or reimbursable EPC. Schedule risks center on long-lead equipment, PSM compliance, and licensor coordination.
hard_deadline_themes: Title V air permit construction approval

typical_risks.description_template: Process licensor {licensor} controls reactor and key proprietary equipment delivery; FAT slips directly drive mechanical completion.
PSSR closure under OSHA PSM is gate to startup; documentation gaps commonly delay first feed by 2-6 weeks.
Site investigation may understate variability in soil bearing or groundwater across {n_acres}-acre plot, driving foundation rework.
Stainless and exotic-alloy welders and instrument fitters are nationally scarce; productivity and rework rates highly sensitive.
Gulf Coast or Southeast site location exposes outdoor construction and modules to hurricane-season disruption.
Licensor PFD revisions or owner capacity uprates during detailed engineering propagate piping, electrical, and structural rework.
First chemical introduction involves toxic/flammable hazards; any deviation triggers lengthy MOC and risk review.

typical_issues.description_template: Reactor vessel ex-works slipped {n_weeks} weeks due to fabricator NDE rework; mechanical completion at risk.
Pipe weld NDE rejection rate trending above {pct}%; welder qualification audit and remediation underway.
Site secured for tropical storm; {n_days} days lost and post-event inspection required.
Pipe rack module sustained transit damage; field repair plan under review.
Management of Change backlog exceeds {n_items}; risk to PSSR closure schedule.
High-pressure piping circuit failed hydrotest; isolation and repair underway.
Loop check identified DCS configuration errors across {n_loops} loops; controls integrator on site.
Cooling tower fill defects discovered during commissioning; vendor remediation required.
Construction-phase fugitive emissions tracking approaching permit limit; controls being augmented.
Initial product samples off-spec on {parameter}; licensor support engaged for diagnostic.

typical_co_drivers: Scope additions for emissions / PSM compliance
